note: ROBOTWORLD roster. Damage/knock/range are in game units; the models in this directory are in the same units, so a `range: 3.4` reaches 3.4 of them. `cardStats` are the 0-10 bars the mech-select screen shows, not the real numbers.

personality.blurb: A decommissioned siege engine that refused to power down. Slow as a glacier, hits like the end of the world. Speaks rarely — mostly in earthquakes.

quotes.intro: "I am the wall. I am the wrecking ball."

capabilities.title: Chargeable light attack
capabilities.means: The light chain is replaced by a hold/release pair: the arm stays wound while the button is held and strikes with banked power on release.

capabilities.title: Chargeable heavy attack
capabilities.means: The heavy is held at its raised keyframe and released, rather than played straight through.

capabilities.title: Charge tell
capabilities.means: The named body region flickers brighter as power banks — the readable warning that a charged blow is coming.

personality.blurb: Ex-military fire-support platform with a laugh setting stuck on maniacal. Believes every problem is just insufficient ammunition.

quotes.intro: "Say hello to my six little friends!"

personality.blurb: A prototype infiltration unit that developed a taste for theatrics. Strikes from angles geometry teachers refuse to acknowledge.

quotes.win: "Ssso predictable. You never even sssaw me."
quotes.intro: "Shall we dance? You won't hear the music."

capabilities.title: Gait table
capabilities.means: Which walk/run cycle this body runs. Bodies SHARE gaits, so tuning one moves every mech that names it.

personality.blurb: One horn. One direction. Zero brakes. RHINO once charged through four buildings to win an argument he was already winning.

quotes.win: "HRRNGH! Next time — bring a wall that works!"

personality.blurb: A weather-control unit that discovered showmanship. Every battle is a concert, every lightning bolt a chord. The crowd goes wild; the crowd is usually on fire.

quotes.win: "⚡ ENCORE? No? Suit yourselves. I was ELECTRIC."

quotes.win: "*low growl* ...The hunt was short. Run faster next time."

quotes.win: "Checkmate was eight shells ago. You just heard it now."

personality.blurb: Officially, this unit was scrapped years ago. Officially, nobody is picking off mechs from 800 meters. Officially, you are perfectly safe.

quotes.win: "...you were dead before the round began."

personality.blurb: A demolition unit whose safety governor "fell off" — twice. Finds fire genuinely hilarious. The laughter you hear over the flames? That's him having the best day ever.

personality.blurb: Guardian of a polar research station, promoted to war machine by boredom. Devastating in combat, insufferable at parties — every joke is about ice, and he thinks they all land.

quotes.win: "Ice to beat you. ...I'm contractually obligated to say that."
quotes.intro: "Chill out. No? Fine — I'll handle it."

capabilities.title: Freezing taunt
capabilities.means: Cross-fades into a solid ice block over half a second and thaws in a sixth of one.

personality.blurb: A deep-sea salvage rig that got tired of being salvaged. Waddled ashore trailing kelp and grudges, shell first, questions never. The claws are non-negotiable.

personality.blurb: Unit MX-7, grown in a black-site lab by a corporation that wanted to end wars by ending everything else. It ate the lab, filed itself as CEO, and went hunting.

capabilities.title: Forelimb carry band
capabilities.means: The arms are weapons held in front, not a jogger`s counter-swing, so every shared clip`s shoulder and elbow pitch is clamped into a measured band.

personality.blurb: Vat-grown smart-slime poured into a bounce-frame with four gunk guns and no indoor voice. Jumps like gravity is a suggestion, lands like a lawsuit.
Dredged from a flooded aquaculture lab, JERRY is a colony pretending to be a mech. The cannons are full of something alive. He would like you to hold still.

quotes.win: "*wet clicking* ...the swarm is fed. For now."

capabilities.title: Surface walking
capabilities.means: This body walks up walls and over roofs. The engine samples nearby geometry into an average outward normal and a nearest point, damps the body toward it, and steps the limbs onto real contact points. `upright` 0 means it becomes part of the wall; near 1 means it stays vertical and hauls itself up by the hands.

personality.blurb: Nobody built NULLBOT. It was simply found in the arena's memory one morning, already undefeated. Where it walks, textures tear, audio stutters, and the scoreboard reads NaN.

quotes.intro: "> fatal exception 0x00NULLBOT :: you will be nullified"

capabilities.title: Glitch taunt
capabilities.means: The taunt breaks the RENDER — a stutter, not a fade.

personality.blurb: Half the mountain gorilla they started with, half the ordnance they bolted on afterward. The engineers called the arm-graft a success. KONGA calls it the smaller fist.

quotes.win: "You brought armor. I brought both arms."
quotes.intro: "*drums chest* ...Come closer. I want to reach you."

quotes.win: "The horns were enough. The guns were courtesy."
